sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 6450 of 2023
Petitioner :- Satyaprakash Mishra Alias Vikash Mishra And Another
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Civil Sectt. Govt. Lko And Oth

Counsel for Petitioner :- Krishna Kumar Dubey Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Anil Kumar Mishra Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned AGA for the State-respondents and Sri Anil Kumar Mishra, Advocate who has filed a Caveat on behalf of opposite party no. 4/informant.

This writ petition has been filed with a prayer to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari for quashing of the First Information Report dated 6.8.2023 registered as FIR No. 0167 of 2023 under Sections 406, 419, 420, 467, 468, 506 IPC at P.S. Karaundikala, District Sultanpur and for a direction to the respondents not to take any coercive steps against the petitioners pursuant to the impugned FIR.
Satyaprakash Mishra Alias Vikash ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46942475/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the brother of the opposite party no. 4 was being ill treated because he was mentally handicapped by the informant and as a result the brother namely Neeraj Tiwari came to the house of petitioners and lived with the petitioners for more than eights months, out of love and affection and gratitude the said Neeraj Tiwari executed a sale deed of his entire share of joint family property in favour of the petitioners.

Learned counsel appearing for the Caveator, however, has pointed out from the FIR itself that Aadhar Card and PAN Card have been fraudulently got made of Neeraj Tiwari showing the mobile number of Satyaprakash Mishra @ Vikash Mishra.
A bank account has also been opened in Bank of Baroda.

Documentary evidence such as copies of bank account's statement and other documents have also been produced before this Court to show that the petitioner no. 1 is a habitual offender and there at least two FIRs lodged against him for similar kinds of fraudulent activity.

He has further submitted that two and half Bighas of land have been alleged to be sold off by Neeraj Tiwari willingly to the petitioner no. 1 for a meagre amount of rupees four lacs although the market value of the land is Rs. 14,50,000/-.
This Court has perused the impugned FIR and the documents that have been produced by the counsel for the Caveator and finds no good ground to show interference in the impugned FIR.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.

Order Date :- 18.8.2023 AKK  Satyaprakash Mishra Alias Vikash ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46942475/
